name: librenms__alerts_get
description: Get alerts from LibreNMS with optional filters.

state.description: Filter the alerts by state: 0 = ok, 1 = alert, 2 = ack. Optional.

severity.description: Filter the alerts by severity. Valid values: ok, warning, critical. Optional.

alert_rule.description: Filter alerts by alert rule ID. Optional.

order.description: How to order the output, default is by timestamp (descending). Can be appended by DESC or ASC to change the order. Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

offset.description: Number of results to skip (offset) for pagination

description: Get details for a specific alert rule by ID.

name: librenms__alert_rule_add
description: Add a new alert rule to LibreNMS.

payload.description:
Alert rule payload fields:
- name (required): Rule name
- builder (required): Rule builder JSON with conditions
- devices (required): Array of device IDs or [-1] for all devices
- severity (required): ok, warning, critical
- count (optional): Trigger threshold count (default: 1)
- delay (optional): Delay before alerting in seconds
- interval (optional): Re-alert interval in seconds
- mute (optional): Mute alerts (true/false)
- invert (optional): Invert rule logic (true/false)
- notes (optional): Rule notes
- disabled (optional): Disable rule (0/1)

Do not include rule_id: LibreNMS would edit that rule instead of adding one.

Example:
{"name": "Device Down", "severity": "critical", "devices": [-1], "builder": {"condition": "AND", "rules": [...]}}

name: librenms__alert_rule_edit
description: Edit an existing alert rule in LibreNMS.

payload.description:
Alert rule edit payload (must include rule_id field):
- rule_id (required): Integer rule ID to edit. Without it LibreNMS would create a new
  rule, so the tool refuses the call.
- name: Rule name
- builder: Rule builder JSON with conditions
- devices: Array of device IDs or [-1] for all devices
- severity: ok, warning, critical
- count: Trigger threshold count
- delay: Delay before alerting in seconds
- interval: Re-alert interval in seconds
- mute: Mute alerts (true/false)
- invert: Invert rule logic (true/false)
- notes: Rule notes
- disabled: Disable rule (0/1)

name: librenms__alert_rule_delete
description: Delete an alert rule from LibreNMS by ID.

name: librenms__devices_list
description: List devices from LibreNMS with optional filters.

query.description:
Query parameters for filtering devices. Examples:
- {"type": "hostname", "query": "router"} - search by hostname substring
- {"type": "os", "query": "linux"} - filter by operating system
- {"type": "location", "query": "datacenter"} - filter by location
- {"type": "up"} or {"type": "down"} - filter by status
- {"order": "hostname ASC"} - sort results

Valid type values: all, active, ignored, up, down, disabled, os, mac, ipv4, ipv6, location, location_id, hostname, sysName, display, device_id, type, serial, version, hardware, features

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

offset.description: Number of results to skip (offset) for pagination

name: librenms__device_add
description: Add a new device to LibreNMS.

payload.description:
Device add payload. Required and optional fields:
- hostname (required): Device hostname or IP
- version (optional): SNMP version (v1, v2c, v3). Default: v2c
- community (required for v1/v2c): SNMP community string
- authlevel (required for v3): noAuthNoPriv, authNoPriv, authPriv
- authname (required for v3): SNMPv3 username
- authpass (required for v3 with auth): Authentication password
- authalgo (optional): MD5 or SHA
- cryptopass (required for authPriv): Privacy password
- cryptoalgo (optional): AES or DES
- port (optional): SNMP port (default: 161)
- transport (optional): udp or tcp
- poller_group (optional): Poller group ID
- force_add (optional): Skip ICMP/SNMP checks (true/false)
- ping_fallback (optional): Add as ping-only if SNMP fails

name: librenms__device_update
description: Update device fields in LibreNMS.

payload.description:
Patchable device fields:
- notes: Device notes/comments
- purpose: Device purpose description
- override_sysLocation: true/false to override SNMP location
- location_id: Location ID to assign
- poller_group: Poller group ID
- ignore: 0/1 to ignore device in alerts
- disabled: 0/1 to disable polling
- snmp_disable: 0/1 to disable SNMP polling
- display_template: Custom display name template (LibreNMS >= 26.5)
- display: Custom display name (LibreNMS < 26.5 only; read-only since 26.5, use display_template)
- type: Device type classification

name: librenms__device_ports_get
description:
Get port info for a device by interface name.

Names like 'Te2/7' can fail by name behind proxies that reject or decode
the encoded slash. The port is then looked up by ID instead; that
response has the same shape but lacks the computed rate fields
(in_rate, out_rate, ...).

name: librenms__ports_search_mac
description:
Find the switch ports where a MAC address was learned (forwarding table).

This searches LibreNMS's FDB data, i.e. where a host's MAC appears on
the network, not the ports' own hardware addresses: a port's own MAC is
not found unless another device learned it. Results are ordered by how
many MACs each port has learned, so the access port the host is
plugged into usually comes first.

mac.description: MAC address of a host to locate (looked up in the forwarding tables, not ports' own MACs). Accepts aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff, aa-bb-cc-dd-ee-ff, aabb.ccdd.eeff, or aabbccddeeff

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

offset.description: Number of results to skip (offset) for pagination
